title: Cosmic Witch Cauldron
description: A blue-skinned witch in a red robe and golden crown stands inside a starry glass conservatory, stirring a glowing cauldron with a large central eye and spiral pupil. The scene is filled with dripping potion bottles, an octopus-like green creature, a taco, a watermelon slice, hot dogs, open books, and colorful magical liquids pooling on the ground under a purple-pink nebula sky.
prompt: A blue-skinned witch wearing a red hooded robe and glowing golden crown stands inside a dark iron-and-glass conservatory filled with stars and pink-purple nebula. She holds a glowing orb and stirs a large black cauldron that has a giant stylized eye with green spiral pupil. Surrounding her are melting colorful potion bottles dripping liquids, a happy green cartoon octopus, a taco, a watermelon slice, hot dogs, and open books, all melting and dripping vibrant blue and pink goo onto the floor, whimsical surreal style, highly detailed, vibrant colors
